newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha softer, falling futures deter buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha softer, falling futures deter buying.

text.p: NWE naphtha eased lower on Tuesday, tracking a slump in crude futures, traders said.
A Suez cargo was offered at $227 cif NWE, but a weaker paper market and a lack of end-user buying interest dampened demand.
Nov swaps talked $2/$3 lower at around $223.
A trading house which said it was bidding up to $226.50 in the morning backed off later, brokers said.
The seller was believed to be working the Suez cargo to the U.S., but a heavy fall on NYMEX gasoline futures closed the arb.
A small Russian cargo was sold on a quotes-related basis.
